# Netrajyoti Eye Centre

> Netrajyoti Eye Centre is a premier, highly-rated ophthalmology clinic and eye hospital located in Dhanbad, Jharkhand, India. We specialize in advanced cataract surgery, retina care, glaucoma treatment, and comprehensive eye diagnostics.

## 👨‍⚕️ Lead Ophthalmologist: Dr. K.P. Gupta
Netrajyoti Eye Centre was founded and is led by Dr. K.P. Gupta, recognized as one of the best eye specialists in Dhanbad.
- **Experience:** Over 22 years of clinical and surgical experience in ophthalmology.
- **Surgical Volume:** Successfully performed more than 5,000 advanced eye surgeries.
- **Education & Training:** M.S. from RIMS Ranchi.
- **Advanced Fellowships:** Prestigious training at Sankar Nethralaya (Chennai) and specialized training at AIIMS (New Delhi).
- **Patient Approach:** Known for a compassionate, highly communicative approach and the use of strictly sterilized, modern diagnostic equipment.

## 🏥 Core Medical Services
We provide modern, affordable, and compassionate eye care for patients of all ages, utilizing state-of-the-art diagnostic and surgical technology.
- **Cataract Surgery:** Advanced, bladeless cataract surgery utilizing modern intraocular lens (IOL) implants. 
- **Retina Care:** Specialized clinical treatment for various retinal disorders and diabetic eye diseases.
- **Glaucoma Treatment:** Early detection diagnostics and comprehensive treatment plans to protect and preserve vision.
- **Complete Eye Checkup:** Thorough vision and eye health examinations using modern diagnostic instruments.
- **On-Site Amenities:** The clinic features an in-house chemist (pharmacy) and integrated testing facilities for ultimate patient convenience.

## ❓ Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q: Who is the main eye specialist at the clinic?**
A: Dr. K.P. Gupta is the lead specialist, highly regarded in Dhanbad with over 22 years of experience and more than 5,000 successful advanced eye surgeries.

**Q: What eye treatments are available at Netrajyoti Eye Centre?**
A: We offer comprehensive eye care, including advanced cataract surgery, specialized retina care, glaucoma treatment, and routine eye checkups using modern diagnostic equipment.

**Q: How can I book an appointment?**
A: Patients can easily book an appointment by calling or sending a WhatsApp message to +91-9341550356. Walk-in visits are also welcome at our Unit 2 clinic in Ayush Vihar, Saraidhela.
